Why is accurate filling of these forms critical for safety?

home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the transition from LP 02 to LP 03 regarding how limitation entries in MOD Form 700C relate to the servicing forms discussed today.

pft_rows.syllabus: Practical on making entries in (specific A/C MOD Form 700C): For entering/removing limitation and husbandry defects in MOD Form 700C, Part 3 flight servicing log for BFS, TRS & AFS, Equipment log card for fitment / removal of equipment & inspections performed, Electrical / Avionics log book entries for scheduled inspection carried out, equipment. Fitment / removal and overhaul due time period, Equipment defect report INA-21 / MOD form 760, Equipment. Maintenance. Job card & Master job card for scheduled / unscheduled maintenance work carried out. & clearing of entries in U/S log MOD Form 700C.
